name: ambientCG API
role: Search and pin CC0 PBR materials, HDRIs and models by id over a JSON API; ZIPs by resolution
summary: ambientcg.com/api/v2/full_json (and a newer v3) lists assets with maps, tags and download sizes; ZIPs come from /get?file=<id>_<res>-<format>.zip. Assets are CC0 1.0, stated on the docs site, not in the API payload. A hosted service run by one person: pin the id, cache the ZIP and record its hash.
use_when: A blender, three-js or pov-ray scene needs a CC0 PBR material (colour, roughness, normal, AO)
Pinning a material by asset id and resolution, with the file hash kept as evidence
avoid_when: Offline or reproducible renders without a local cache: the service is hobbyist-run and its docs promise no stability
Measured material values for physically exact work: ambientCG maps are photographs and approximations
Interpreting or applying the maps once downloaded: materials and the renderer's own guide

install.macos: none: curl or fetch; unzip for the archive

notes: 2026-11-27: Lead said API terms and rate limits unverified. docs.ambientcg.com/api/ states no rate limit and no terms; it warns the service is run by one person for hobbyists and educators and may not be as stable as an enterprise application. Keep requests few, anonymous and cached.

2026-11-27: Lead said v3 status unverified. v3 is live (/api/v3/assets returns JSON; docs describe assets, categories, collections, rss, user; a Patreon bearer token unlocks paid benefits only). The fixture uses v2 full_json, which is documented and still answers.

2026-11-27: The v2 payload has no licence field. CC0 comes from docs.ambientcg.com/license (covers files and preview renders; credit optional). The ZIP contains no licence file, so keep the docs URL and fetch date with the asset record (ADR 0011: an asset needs rights evidence).
2026-11-27: Download links redirect to a tokenised storage URL; always request /get?file=, never store the redirect. Both NormalDX and NormalGL ship in each ZIP; pick the one the renderer expects.

assessment.rationale: Docs read and the API called anonymously. Nothing catalogued sources CC0 materials by id; imagemagick and blender only process files you hold. Catalogue home fits (iconify is the precedent for an asset source); library intake stays ADR 0011's. No release history, terms or rate limit published.

evidence.result: PavingStones036_1K-JPG.zip fetched once and cached: 9354813 bytes equal to the API size, sha256 91223aa4...e9ce, six 1024x1024 maps, DX+GL green means sum to 255. KNOWN FAIL: payload has no licence field; CC0 is on the docs page.
evidence.scope: One asset, one fetch day: later drift in files or API is unobserved. Service stability, rate limits, v3, HDRIs and models untested. Licence rests on the docs page, not the API.
